turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
We've barely started, Hale. I have until 4:40, and you haven't answered me. Tell me on what basis the zero was entered, or take it off.
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing has been resolved, and if you write that I agreed to anything, I'll be putting that in front of the principal. I'm writing down that you asked me for it. Withdraw the zero, Hale.
I've answered that. I'm not saying it, and I'm not leaving until the zero is addressed. What do you have on Owen's essay, Hale?
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
Asking a third time doesn't change my answer. I don't agree to something because I'm told to. If there's a document behind that zero, put it on the desk.
